messages:
alice: deploy-bot paused the release during preflight. it flagged an env annotation mismatch between staging and prod :warning:
alice: staging has `redwood.io/secret-scope: svc-secrets/staging-app` but prod does not. blocking canary promotion. link: https://deploychecks.internal/1754242424 :link:
deploy-bot: RELEASE PAUSED — preflight failed: annotation-parity-check
deploy-bot: details: missing annotation 'redwood.io/secret-scope' in namespace 'prod' for service 'inference-api' (present in staging). Automatic rollback disabled.
ben: :eyes: ok, how did that get removed? was there a helm value change?
carla: last change touched helm chart values for annotations, iirc. PR #3421 updated `extraAnnotations` but only for staging overlay.
dave: can we hotpatch prod to add the annotation without a full rollout? what are the risks?
eva: if it's just an annotation for KMS access, adding it should be low-risk, but we need to ensure the value matches prod secret path exactly. double-check with secrets team.
release-coordinator: option A: hotpatch prod annotation (fast, minimal downtime). option B: roll back the whole release to previous image (safer for config drift). need decision in next 20m due to change window.
carla: i prefer hotpatch and re-run preflight. rollback will affect dependent releases.
ben: agree with hotpatch but let's pin the image we were about to promote so we don't accidentally promote again until checks clear.
dave: doing a kubectl patch. command:
```
kubectl -n prod patch service inference-api --type=json -p='[{"op":"add","path":"/metadata/annotations/redwood.io~1secret-scope","value":"svc-secrets/prod-app"}]'
```
dave: running now :computer:
devops-bot: started patch job (job id: jb-8891). notifying secrets-team.
carla: i'll validate the annotation value with secrets-team (ping @secrets-team)
eva: heads-up: update release notes draft to mention config parity fix and pin decision. i'll take that.
dave: patch applied, waiting for deploy-bot recheck. logs: `annotation set -> meta diff applied`
deploy-bot: RE-RUN PREFLIGHT — annotation-parity-check: PASS
deploy-bot: all checks green, resuming release window.
release-coordinator: decision logged: hotpatch prod annotation, pinned image sha f3a9b2c for promotion freeze until end of rollout. noted in release notes and changelog.
ben: can we add a lint check to prevent chart overlays from omitting critical annotations? ticket incoming.
carla: filing infra ticket: INFRA-582 - enforce required-annotations in releasechecks.
eva: updated release notes: "Hotfix: restored missing prod annotation redwood.io/secret-scope; pinned image f3a9b2c during rollout." sending to CS for customer-facing note.
release-coordinator: thanks everyone. reopening the channel if regressions appear. :shipit: 
alice: closing thread, marking postmortem not required for now but we'll track INFRA-582.
